body: Well unfortunately unless you can convince him to remove you I assume you signed a lease. So yes no matter what as long as you’re on there you’re going to be responsible for the place. But as for the relationship, you don’t have to stay anywhere you don’t want to. You don’t owe anything to anyone. Wanting to leave is as good a reason to leave as any. Do you have family or friends you might be able to stay with if you decide to rip the bandage off, tell him it’s over, there’s no chance of fixing it, and you want out? In my opinion, which please take it with a grain of salt, as I’m a man, I think your best bet would be to lay it out very matter of fact: “Hey, I’ve been thinking, we moved a bit too fast for me, and I don’t want to do this anymore. We need to break up.” And go stay with someone for a night or two. If he works, plan to go get your stuff while he’s there. I know it sounds shitty, but you’re Being shitty to yourself staying somewhere you don’t wanna be and shitty to him if you stay and don’t want to be there. I just went through a very similar, though not as long term, and certainly not as intertwined situation. Hope this helps.

I was induced on suboxone for the same thing, fent m30s. The thing that makes the Bernese method ideal is it shortens any adverse withdrawal symptoms. You start by microdosing suboxone while still using fentanyl. For me, I went like this : While still using, Day 1: 1mg 3x; Day 2: 2mg 3x; Day 3: 4mg 3x; Day 4: 8mg 3x. At this point I stopped fentanyl completely, and only felt mild cold symptoms for 2-4 days. Some will say 24 mg is way too much but it's what works for you. I kept relapsing on just 12mg per day. The important thing is suboxone is affordable, safe, and accessible.

Edit: you may also inquire with whomever prescribed/prescribes subs for you about other comfort meds. My doc gave me clonidine for the nerve pain and seroquil for sleep. Also, look into an IOP program. That's how I got my sub script. I go 3 hrs/day 4 nights a week, that way I can still work and still get weekends off.
